Job Title: Technical Support Specialist

Employment Type: Regular, Full-time

Team: Customer Success

Reports to: Senior Manager, Customer Success

Location: US – Remote

About Us:

SimpliGovis a leading government workflow automation platform that helps state and local agencies digitize and streamline mission-critical processes. Its form-building, workflow-routing, document-management, and digital-signature capabilities replace manual work with secure, auditable digital workflows. Trusted by hundreds of U.S. government agencies,SimpliGovdelivers secure, dependable SaaS technology and an exceptional customer experience.

We are growing rapidly and looking for talented, high-impact players to join our team!

Role Overview:

The Technical Support Specialist supports SimpliGov’s SaaS platform while protecting the reliability, security, and integrity of customer environments. This role investigates complex technical issues, communicates clearly with customers and internal teams, and drives incidents through diagnosis, resolution, and root-cause documentation. Leveraging AI tools, this position continuously maximizes efficiency and effectiveness in operations and reporting.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically curious, and security-minded, with the ability to partner across Support, Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success to resolve issues, validate fixes, improve operations, and strengthen the customer experience.

Responsibilities:

Technical Support

  • Own escalated customer issues involving application behavior, data, workflows, integrations, authentication, connectivity, and performance
  • Proficiency using generative AI tools to accelerate technical research, troubleshooting, case analysis, and documentation.
  • Ability to create clear, structured prompts that provide appropriate context, constraints, examples, and desired output formats.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants to develop, explain, review, and troubleshoot SQL queries, PowerShell scripts, API requests, JSON, and XML.
  • Ability to use AI to summarize logs, identify patterns, generate diagnostic hypotheses, and recommend investigation steps.
  • Strong judgment in independently validating AI-generated queries, scripts, technical conclusions, and customer communications before use.
  • Knowledge of secure and responsible AI practices, including protecting customer data, credentials, personally identifiable information, confidential information, and proprietary code.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted knowledge management, including drafting knowledge-base articles, incident summaries, root-cause analyses, and troubleshooting runbooks.
  • Ability to evaluate new AI tools and identify responsible opportunities to improve support quality, response time, and operational efficiency.
  • Understanding of prompt-injection risks and the need to treat untrusted customer content, documents, logs, and websites cautiously when using AI-enabled tools.
  • Ability to explain AI-assisted findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences without overstating certainty.
  • Use diagnostics, logs, and approved tools to investigate issues and execute support procedures
  • Reproduce issues, isolate causes, document findings, and determine resolution or escalation paths
  • Communicate timely, accurate updates to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle
  • Maintain complete and actionable case documentation in Jira Service Management and related support systems
  • Troubleshoot customer identity and access configurations
  • Diagnose certificate, networking, and web application connectivity issues across customer and SimpliGov environments

Integrations, APIs & Cloud Operations

  • Troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations using standard support tools
  • Supportcloud services related to identity, networking, monitoring, and application hosting
  • Analyze telemetry using available monitoring and diagnostics tools, including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics
  • Research and resolve issues involving Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph API, and other connected business applications
  • Maintain safe, repeatable queries, scripts, and runbooks

Product Quality & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to validate defects, assess customer impact, and track resolution
  • Test bug fixes and release candidates, confirm production outcomes, and communicate relevant changes to Support and customer-facing teams
  • Collaborate with Professional Services and Customer Success on complex implementations, integrations, and customer environment issues
  • Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, and training
  • Identifyrecurring support trends and recommend product or process improvements
  • Produce reporting dashboards, trend analysis and executive reporting packages

Qualifications:

  • 3-5+ years of progressive technical experience in a software company
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent combination of relevant education, certifications, and professional experience.
  • Demonstrated track record of troubleshooting technical issues and explaining complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, internally and externally
  • Ability to independently learn unfamiliar software platforms and business systems, and interpret technical documentation, system logs, API documentation, and vendor resources.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across SaaS applications, integrations, databases, cloud services, and logs
  • Proficiency using approved generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to support technical research, log analysis, SQL and PowerShell development, API troubleshooting, case documentation, and knowledge creation.
  • Ability to critically evaluate and independently validate AI-generated technical recommendations, queries, scripts, and conclusions before applying them in customer or production environments.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, information security, appropriate handling of customer information, and compliance with organizational AI-use policies.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, identity protocols, DNS, SSL/TLS, networking, and web application connectivity
  • Familiarity with APIs, data formats, Postman, Jira Service Management, service desk operations, and enterprise software platforms
  • Clear technical communication for case notes, customer updates, documentation, and internal guidance
  • Strong customer focus, prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement mindset

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, with significant employer contributions for employees AND dependents (contributions based on base-level plan; buyup plans available at additional costs)
  • Company-sponsored life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance
  • 11 Paid holidays
  • Flexible time off
  • 401k plan with 4% employer match
  • Monthly home office stipend
  • Monthly wellness stipend

Why Join SimpliGov?

At SimpliGov, you’ll be part of a mission‑driven team transforming how government works. We help state and local agencies modernize their processes and deliver better services to their communities. As a Customer Success Manager, you will gain hands‑on experience working with customers, technology teams, and real public‑impact projects—while developing the skills and experience needed to advance your career.

SimpliGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive team.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Legal Disclaimers:

SimpliGov does not currently sponsor applicants for work visas.

The US base salary range for this full-time position begins at $85,000 + bonus and benefits. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

SimpliGov participates in the federal government's E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of all newly hired employees and most existing employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. For new hires, the E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience:

raw.description:
About the Role

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) backend engineering role at a well-funded Series A startup building an AI-enabled, device-agnostic risk-management platform for cold-chain logistics. The platform helps pharma and perishables shippers and carriers reduce product loss, improve operational efficiency, and make smarter decisions in real time — answering who, what, when, where, and how for every shipment.

You'll be a key technical voice on a lean, high-velocity team of ~27, designing and shipping the distributed systems that sit at the heart of the product. Your work directly protects high-value shipments that people depend on.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build backend services powering the logistics orchestration and decision-intelligence platform.

  • Own data-heavy distributed systems that contextualize IoT monitoring data and quantify shipment risk in real time.

  • Build predictive systems for OTIF (on-time, in-full) performance and automate exception-handling workflows.

  • Architect and maintain event-driven pipelines for high-volume IoT data ingestion and processing.

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to influence product and architecture decisions.

  • Champion software engineering best practices: testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.

  • Build for scale and reliability in a domain where uptime and accuracy genuinely matter.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5–15 years of backend engineering experience building scalable, distributed systems.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language: Python, Java, Go, or Rust (strong Java and/or Python preferred).

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data-heavy distributed systems.

  • Experience with IoT data ingestion, processing, and contextualization.

  • Proficiency with relational databases (SQL) and data modeling; experience with NoSQL databases and ETL pipelines is a plus.

  • Experience building event-driven architectures and working with messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.

  • Experience deploying and operating services on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Experience with API design and development (REST and/or gRPC).

  • Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills; ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions.

  • Eligibility to work in the United States or ability to obtain visa sponsorship (sponsorship available).

Nice to Have

  • Domain knowledge in logistics, cold chain, shipment risk quantification, or OTIF prediction.

  • Prior experience at logistics-tech, supply-chain, or IoT-focused companies.

  • Familiarity with data security, privacy, and regulatory requirements relevant to pharma or cold-chain domains.

  • Prior work at a growth-stage or Series A startup.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $130,000 – $160,000 USD annually

  • Equity participation

  • Cash bonus

  • Visa sponsorship available

Location & Work Arrangement

Fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States. US-aligned working hours required. The company has offices in Indianapolis, IN and Austin, TX.

Interview Process

  1. Manager introductory chat

  2. Take-home technical assessment

  3. Final interview

raw.description:
COMPANY


ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

We’re looking for a performance-minded AI Video Editor to help power RYZE’s paid social advertising engine on Meta.

This is a highly executional, fast-paced role at the intersection of performance marketing, video editing, and generative AI. You’ll take raw footage, scripts, concepts, and creative briefs and turn them into high-performing social ads - using both traditional editing techniques and the latest AI video, image, voice, and creative-generation tools.

We’re especially interested in people who actively experiment with tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, OpenArt, and other emerging AI video and creative platforms and understand how to turn them into useful assets for performance advertising.

This is not a brand-only editing role. Performance, speed, experimentation, iteration, and creative problem-solving matter here.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Edit raw footage into high-quality, conversion-focused social ads for Meta.

  • Transform scripts, concepts, storyboards, and creative briefs into compelling short-form ads.

  • Use generative AI to create and enhance video, images, animations, product visuals, backgrounds, transitions, b-roll, and other creative assets.

  • Explore and actively use AI video and creative tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, OpenArt, and emerging platforms to develop new advertising concepts.

  • Create multiple creative variations quickly - including different hooks, openings, visual concepts, pacing, CTAs, and messaging.

  • Add captions, sound design, music, transitions, effects, b-roll, and motion graphics to maximize engagement and clarity.

  • Develop strong first 1-3 second hooks designed to stop the scroll.

  • Maintain strong pacing, flow, timing, and visual hierarchy optimized for paid social performance.

  • Write and apply clear, accurate, compelling English captions and on-screen messaging.

  • Use Adobe Premiere Pro as the primary editing tool, with After Effects and Photoshop as needed.

  • Manage multipe ads and creative iterations simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality.

  • Incorporate creative feedback quickly and efficiently.

  • Review basic performance metrics such as thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, and conversion performance to inform future creative iterations.

  • Turn performance insights into new creative tests and variations.

  • Stay ahead of emerging AI video, animation, and creative-generation technologies and identify tools that can improve RYZE’s creative output.

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of hands-on video editing experience, ideally in performance marketing, paid social, DTC, or e-commerce.

  • Proven experience creating short-form paid social ads for platforms such as Meta.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating performance-driven creative and AI animation - not just polished brand videos.

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro; working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.

  • Experience with tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, OpenArt, Veo3, or similar AI creative platforms.

  • A strong understanding of how to use AI-generated content in service of advertising performance, rather than simply creating visually impressive AI videos.

  • Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, captions, sound design, and direct-response creative.

CHARACTERISTICS

  • Performance-first creative mindset — every edit is evaluated against whether it will convert, not whether it looks impressive. Understands the difference between a beautiful video and an effective ad.

  • AI-native workflow — doesn't use AI as a novelty or shortcut. Has a genuine, considered point of view on which tools earn their place in a production pipeline and how to integrate generated assets into polished, conversion-ready creative.

  • Hook obsession— the first 1–3 seconds are not an afterthought. Approaches every brief by identifying the strongest possible scroll-stopper before anything else gets built.

  • Iteration velocity — can produce multiple creative variations — different hooks, pacing, CTAs, visual concepts — quickly and without treating each as a fresh creative project. Volume and speed are part of the job.

  • Data-literate creative — reads performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, conversion) and translates them into creative decisions. Doesn't wait to be told what the data means.

  • Tool curiosity— actively experiments with emerging AI video and creative platforms before being asked to. Knows what Higgsfield, Kling, Veo3, and OpenArt can and can't do right now, and updates that view regularly.

  • Structured under speed— manages multiple ads and iterations simultaneously without losing track of versions, feedback states, or delivery timelines. Fast doesn't mean disorganized.

  • Feedback-efficient — incorporates direction quickly, asks clarifying questions upfront rather than mid-execution, and doesn't require the same note twice.


WHAT WE OFFER

raw.description:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.

About the Role

Submittable is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to own our engineering vision, architecture, and execution as we continue to scale. This is a pivotal leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, responsible for building and leading a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization spanning India and the US. The CTO will partner closely with Product, Sales, and the broader Executive Leadership Team to translate strategic vision into technical execution including platform stability, scalable architecture, and cross-border effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and own the multi-year technology roadmap and architecture strategy in alignment with business goals
  • Evaluate and evolve the technology stack to support scalability, security, and reliability
  • Champion product stability and platform resilience as a top engineering priority
  • Own build-vs-buy and vendor/technology partnership decisions
  • Maintenance of legacy platforms and potential for migration strategies, profit optimization

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead a distributed engineering organization across US and India
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent; build a strong leadership bench
  • Establish engineering best practices: code quality, testing, CI/CD, incident response, and security posture
  • Drive cross-border collaboration and communication practices to close gaps between distributed teams

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product on roadmap prioritization and technical feasibility
  • Work with Sales and Customer Success to address technical escalations and enterprise requirements
  • Represent engineering in ELT strategic planning, budgeting, and board-level initiatives

Operational Excellence

  • Own engineering KPIs (i.e. uptime/reliability, velocity, technical debt reduction, defect reporting, AI utilization/leverage, etc.)
  • Oversee security and compliance team inclusive of SOC II audits, pen testing, privacy compliance, etc.
  • Manage engineering budget, Saas platform margin, headcount planning, and vendor contracts
  • Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and industry regulations relevant to SaaS

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in senior technology leadership (CTO or equivalent) at a SaaS company
  • Proven experience leading distributed/global engineering teams, ideally including India-based teams
  • Track record of scaling engineering organizations through growth stages (startup to mid-market SaaS)
  • Demonstrated experience building or scaling AI/ML-powered product features and driving AI adoption within an engineering organization"
  • Strong technical foundation in modern web architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), APIs, and data security
  • Experience partnering with executive leadership on business strategy, not just technical execution
  • Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and the board
  • Experience with M&A technical due diligence, platform migrations, or major re-architecture projects is a plus

Success Metrics (First 12 Months)

  • Established technical roadmap aligned to ELT strategic priorities
  • Measurable improvement in platform stability and uptime
  • Strengthened US/India engineering collaboration model
  • Key senior engineering leadership hires and retention milestones met

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Submittable will NEVER request bank details, payment, or personal information during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to . (Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)

Why Submittable?

Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.

At Submittable, you’ll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!

Benefits: We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full-time employees, including:

  • Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts
  • 401(k) plan with employer match starting day one
  • Equity stock options to share in our success
  • Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave
  • Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents
  • Professional development stipends to support your career growth
  • Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs
  • Monthly company-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Submittable, we believe technology is a force for good, driving social impact and enabling corporate social responsibility on a global scale. To achieve this, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values inclusion and belonging as central pillars of our culture.

We embrace the strength of our diverse community by creating a safe space where employees feel empowered to share ideas, celebrate unique experiences, and learn from one another. By prioritizing inclusion, we aim to build an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and make innovative contributions that enable our customers to tackle complex challenges and spread more good.

As a globally used platform, we are dedicated to hiring and supporting employees who represent a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. This includes diversity in ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, religion, ability, culture, and socioeconomic background.

About Our Process

Our goal is a fair, efficient, and thorough evaluation process that benefits you and our team and respects your time. As you can imagine, we have received a high volume of applications. Your willingness to participate in I.D. Verification and answer a few questions early allows us to move through the process more quickly.

Let's Talk About AI:

Guidelines for using AI in our Hiring Process: At Submittable, we believe that Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for good. We are committed to leveraging AI technologies responsibly, ensuring their use is equitable, fair and safe. To ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during take home tests or interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, please let us know.

For additional information and guidance on using AI to prepare an interview at Submittable, please clickhere.

We believe our approach streamlines the hiring process and respects your time by ensuring that every conversation is substantive and focused on your unique qualifications. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to learning more about you.

Location: Brazil

Please submit your resume in English.

Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals globally. We serve over 2,000 customers—including over 50% of the Fortune 100—across 30+ countries.

At Quorum, our "product" isn't just our software; it’s our people. We are looking for a 100% remote Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Team—the engine behind Quorum’s AI strategy. This isn't just a coding role; it’s an opportunity to build the advanced AI solutions that help the world’s most influential organizations navigate the legislative landscape.

The Impact You’ll Have

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of features that impact thousands of clients. You will bridge the gap between complex datasets and intuitive user experiences, leveraging AI to automate the "administrative drag" of public affairs. You’ll be a key architect of our unified codebase, ensuring our tools remain reliable, efficient, and cutting-edge.

Your Journey at Quorum

  • First Week: You’ll hit the ground running and ship your first piece of code to production.

  • First Month: You’ll be working across the stack—from infrastructure and APIs to the UI.

  • First Six Months: You’ll take full ownership of a feature set, making technical decisions that directly impact our global client base.

  • First Year: You’ll help guide the team on broad technical decisions that shape our stack and the growth of the entire company.

About You

  • The Expert: You have 7+ years of experience building software for end-users, with deep mastery of backend languages (we use Python/Django) and relational databases (PostgreSQL).

  • AI-Forward: You are excited about the potential of artificial intelligence and want to design systems that leverage AI to solve real-world problems.

  • A Designer & Builder: You don't just write code; you design complex systems, write technical documentation, and implement your vision.

  • The "Owner" Mentality: You care deeply about the quality of your code and are committed to building the skills of those around you through mentorship and thoughtful code reviews.

  • Self-Starter: You’re a motivated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is excited to pitch in wherever needed, from recruiting to customer support.

About the Software Development Team

  • We’re a fast-growing team that is dedicated to improving our people, processes, and platform. The 100+ person team is composed of different functions including software engineering, Product Management, Product Design, QA, Devops/SRE and an Information Security team.

  • We support many different products but internally think of them as one system with a single unified codebase. Our goal is to build centralized systems that handle complex problems for multiple features and products.

  • We’re focused on doing the important things the right way -- we write solid documentation, test our code well, design for scale, and follow defined software development processes.

  • We follow best-in-class security practices to safeguard our data and application against bad actors. We regularly test and update processes and technology to fight complacency, because we know good security is a continuous effort.

  • We curate high-quality datasets that are essential for effective mapping and tracking of the government and public affairs spaces. Our datasets underpin our promise to give users the information necessary to make smart decisions that influence policy.

  • We set rigorous quality standards and monitor them with a mix of programmatic and manual verifications to ensure users maintain a high degree of trust in our systems.

  • We’re very close as a team and invest not only in each others’ skills and careers but also in building real relationships with one another: product development is a team sport and we believe that it’s better (and more fun) to work on a team of people that you know well and care about.

Our Work Environment

  • We are an AI-forward team—AI is built into how we work, think, and grow.

  • We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.

Do you want to learn what it's like to have a real impact at a fast-growing company that is changing the way the advocacy process works? If so, drop us a line. We'd love to talk to you!

Compensation Structure

  • This is a full time CLT position.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Standard Brazil holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter is dedicated to your professional development!

  • Monthly Work from Home Stipend

  • Mental and Dental Care by SulAmérica

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Mental Health stipend

  • Flash Voucher

  • In company English classes

  • Community groups open to all team members

  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave

Location: Brazil

Please submit your resume in English.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

At Quorum, we utilize modern talent acquisition tools, including our Applicant Tracking System, Ashby, to assist our recruiting team. Through automation, analytics, and AI, Northspyre gives teams the real-time information, performance insights, and workflow tools they need to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. By bringing project stakeholders, data, and processes together all on one integrated platform, Northspyre eliminates expensive silos in the development lifecycle, making project delivery simple and outcomes more predictable. Since 2017, Northspyre has been the backbone of operational infrastructure for leading development firms, supporting over $500 billion in projects across the US.

About the opportunity:

In this role, you are the editorial and brand authority for Northspyre. You are obsessed with understanding real estate developers - how they think, how they make decisions, and what they actually trust — and be adept with translating that understanding into credible, high-quality editorial output. You have a relentless focus on execution and judgment, and you are comfortable both producing work yourself and leading others to do the same.

You bring a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive narratives, and category positioning. You are able to synthesize complex inputs - data, industry trends, operator insight, and leadership perspective - into clear points of view that earn trust with sophisticated audiences. You care deeply about quality and credibility, and you make thoughtful editorial decisions to maintain both..

As Head of Brand & Editor-in-Chief, you will build Northspyre’s media and editorial engine from the ground up. You will evolve traditional B2B marketing approaches toward a newsroom-led model rooted in credibility, insight, and real market intelligence. Your mandate is to establish Northspyre as the authoritative voice for real estate development - not through promotion, but through judgment, original thinking, and substantive editorial work.

In this role you get to:

  • Own the newsroom and drive execution
    • Own and operate the editorial calendar, shipping multiple pieces of content per day across formats.
    • Set the pace for the function with strong organization, follow-through, and project management.
    • Move ideas quickly from concept to published work without sacrificing quality.
    • Act as final editor and copyeditor to ensure clarity, credibility, and consistency.
  • Generate, produce, and shape authoritative content
    • Consistently generate original story, format, and franchise ideas grounded in real market insight.
    • Personally write, edit, and ship core editorial content tied to real estate development, capital, risk, and market dynamics.
    • Set the quality bar through your own output
    • Bring a steady stream of thoughtful, relevant ideas without waiting for direction or briefs.
  • Build credibility through leadership and market immersion
    • Lead a small, high-standards editorial team.
    • Lead as a player–coach: deeply involved in the work while developing others.
    • Stay deeply embedded in the real estate development market through regular conversations, networking, and relationship-building.
    • Translate company strategy, proprietary data, and market signal into authoritative editorial narratives.
    • Partner closely with the CEO and executive team.
    • Decide what Northspyre will publish in order to maintain trust and authority.

We are looking for people who have:

  • Real estate development fluency, ideally with 6–12 years of industry experience, including exposure to development, acquisitions, capital markets, or adjacent roles that require credibility with developers.
  • A background that supports insight on complex development topics (e.g., development management, acquisitions, research, or real estate journalism).
  • A track record of personally producing high-quality written or editorial content focused on real estate development, the built environment, capital projects, or adjacent markets (e.g., CRE, infrastructure, construction, finance, or urban economics) where judgment, taste, and point of view mattered.
  • Strong copyediting instincts and an eye for clarity, structure, and precision.
  • A demonstrated pattern of generating original ideas and proactively bringing them forward.
  • Strong project-management skills and comfort owning a fast-moving, multi-stream content calendar.
  • Experience leading or mentoring others while remaining hands-on in the work.
  • A newsroom mindset - able to operate with urgency, judgment, and limited structure.
  • High curiosity about real estate development as a system, with clear evidence of ongoing self-directed interest.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage and build rapport quickly.

Benefits and Perks

  • In addition to a competitive salary, we are offering a meaningful stock option package
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision. Multiple plan options, including a plan option for 100% employer-paid premium for individual coverage for full-time employees.
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (Fully vested after 6 mo eligibility period)
  • Unlimited Vacation, Paid Sick Leave, and major US Holidays
  • Awesome company swag!
  • Free access to Health Advocate
  • Hybrid & Remote opportunities - we have an Amazing new office in Midtown Atlanta
  • You will be part of a small, professional fast-moving team with minimal supervision
  • Annual team gatherings

Top Three Reasons to Join

#1: It’s the Right Time – We’ve already facilitated more than $500 billion of complex projects across the United States

#2. Northspyre has the right product – Our technology empowers modern real estate teams to build leveraging data, automation and artificial intelligence to get to faster, more predictable outcomes on complex projects.

#3. Northspyre celebrates a culture of creativity – We strive to have a sense of community within Northspyre that encourages diverse viewpoints, openness, and fostering an environment in which employees feel comfortable bringing their whole authentic selves to work.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

Who You Are

  • A systems builder with playbooks “on playbooks” for recruiting attendees, measuring impact, and monetizing programs.
  • Hands-on and data-literate; you tie events to pipeline and revenue and can prove the return.
  • Someone who thinks about scale unconventionally and reaching more of the market in ways competitors can’t or won’t.
  • A strong operator and people leader who can run many events and motions at once across diverse product lines without dropping the craft.
  • High-agency, creative, and at ease working with brand, growth, partnerships, supply, sales, and external vendors and agencies.

Job Description

  • Teamcenter Data Architect
  • Full Time
  • Remote

The Teamcenter Data Architect plays a key role in designing and configuring a compliant Teamcenter Business Modeler IDE (BMIDE) data model. This role is primarily hands-on, responsible for building, extending, and maintaining the PLM data model while ensuring alignment with enterprise design standards and Navy mission requirements. The position contributes directly to establishing a unified, cost-effective, and mission-ready PLM environment that reduces delivery timelines, improves data consistency, and enables a single source of truth across the Naval Enterprise. The role balances practical implementation with targeted design responsibilities to ensure the data model is scalable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term Navy Enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (NPLM) objectives. The ideal candidate has 3-5 years of experience working in a similar capacity on any large enterprise system implementation/integration project specific to engineering or manufacturing.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain Teamcenter data models using BMIDE, including object types, attributes, relationships, and business rules.
  • Develop, deploy, and support BMIDE templates and extensions across development and production environments.
  • Translate Navy engineering, logistics, and lifecycle management requirements into scalable, maintainable PLM data structures.
  • Apply and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and BMIDE best practices to ensure consistency, reusability, and compliance across the NPLM solution.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive data documentation, including data dictionaries, schema diagrams, and metadata definitions, to support transparency, governance, and knowledge transfer.
  • Support the evolution of the Teamcenter data model architecture, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and interoperability requirements.
  • Conduct impact analysis and implement controlled updates to the data model to support system integrations and evolving mission needs.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, developers, and functional stakeholders to align data model design with system capabilities and business requirements.
  • Partner with data governance and architecture teams to promote a single source of truth, reduce data duplication, and align with enterprise data standards.
  • Support testing, validation, and troubleshooting of BMIDE configurations, including resolving schema conflicts, deployment issues, and data inconsistencies.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline
  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting enterprise system implementations (e.g., PLM, ERP, MRP, DevSecOps, or CRM)
  • Experience with data modeling, data migration, data mapping, and legacy system consolidation
  • Familiarity with configuration management, version control, and deployment processes
  • Ability to interpret technical and functional requirements and translate them into scalable data model solutions
  • Experience creating and maintaining structured data documentation, such as data dictionaries, schema definitions, and related artifacts
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and documentation/collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance or be able to receive and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Teamcenter BMIDE development and configuration, including creation and management of business objects, attributes, relationships, LOVs, compound properties, and relation types
  • Ability to configure and extend Teamcenter behavior using BMIDE features such as conditions, rules, runtime properties, and other extensions
  • Strong understanding of PLM data modeling concepts and object-oriented data structures, with the ability to design scalable and maintainable models
  • Experience working within enterprise system environments, including system integrations and data exchange mechanisms (e.g., SOA services, XML, JSON)
  • Familiarity with Teamcenter ITK and/or server-side customization concepts to effectively collaborate with developers and understand downstream impacts of data model changes
  • Experience supporting or configuring Active Workspace and understanding how BMIDE configurations are represented in the user interface
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and resolving data model issues, including schema conflicts, deployment errors, and environment inconsistencies
  • Understanding of underlying database concepts (e.g., tables, indexing, normalization) and their impact on Teamcenter data persistence and performance optimization
  • Experience defining and applying data standards, naming conventions, and metadata management practices within large-scale systems
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts, including metadata management, data quality, and alignment with enterprise data architecture
  • CompTIA Security+ Certification

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • This position may require the ability to travel up to 5%.

Job Title: Falcon MLR Strategy - US

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

MLR review is one of the Life Science industry's biggest bottlenecks - and we're rebuilding it with AI.

Falcon MLR is Veeva's AI application for medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review. Our AI agents review promotional material the way expert reviewers do: against the actual rules of each market and the science behind the claims. We're looking for an MLR expert to take ownership of review quality across the US.

You have sat in the review meetings. You know the codes, the process, and their pain points. Now, help build the reviewer and shape the future of MLR for the entire Life Science industry. You'll work directly with Falcon MLR's founding team, and your judgment will ship into a product used globally by the top Pharmaceutical companies.

We work like a start-up inside Veeva. The team is small, you own your area end to end, and your decisions reach the product fast. It suits people who like to build and take ownership.

Jobs that combine deep MLR expertise with frontier AI barely exist. This is one.

What You'll Do

    • Maximize reviewer agreement with Falcon's findings across the US market
    • Lead our regulatory monitoring system with engineering and product, and coordinate with other regions
    • Operationalize the reviewer-feedback loop, turning customer inputs into product improvements
    • Investigate, diagnose and resolve “why did Falcon flag this?” - read the agent's traces, find the root cause, fix it. Build the process for handling these questions with users
    • Automate recurring tasks with AI workflows
    • Ownership of quality benchmarks e.g. review quality, in cross-functional collaboration with engineering and product

Requirements

    • You have been part of MLR/PRC review of promotional material - in pharma, biotech or at an agency serving one
    • You know the US rules - FDA/OPDP requirements and the PhRMA Code
    • You have reviewed both HCP- and consumer-directed promotional materials and can assess claims against the Prescribing Information and supporting evidence
    • You learn dense regulatory and legal material fast - and have results to show
    • AI is already part of your daily work - you have automated parts of your own job and want to go further
    • You have high agency and entrepreneurial spirit - you have built something of your own, at work or outside it, and you do not wait to be told what to do
    • You have worked hands-on in Vault PromoMats - reviews, annotations, claims libraries
    • You live in the US

Nice to Have

    • You're on the US East Coast - your working day overlaps with our Copenhagen team

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $180,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. Preferred

Raventra Health is a medical services company providing outsourced billing, coding, and claims processing solutions for provider groups and hospitals. As an AR Follow-Up Specialist, you will manage aged accounts receivable for provider clients, following up on unpaid and underpaid claims and working with payers to resolve outstanding balances. You will help improve collections, reduce aging, and identify recurring issues that may be affecting reimbursement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Manage an assigned accounts receivable portfolio, prioritizing accounts by age, balance, and recovery potential

  • Follow up on unpaid and underpaid claims through payer portals and by phone

  • Research claim status, payment history, and outstanding balances to determine appropriate next steps

  • Submit appeals and reconsiderations with supporting documentation when appropriate

  • Escalate unresolved claims through payer channels when standard follow-up does not resolve the issue

  • Maintain accurate documentation of follow-up activities, payer responses, and next steps

  • Monitor AR aging and recovery performance for assigned accounts

  • Identify recurring denial, payment, or claims issues and communicate trends to billing and coding teams

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare accounts receivable follow-up or medical billing

  • Experience following up with insurance payers on unpaid and underpaid claims

  • Working knowledge of AR aging, claim status, denials, and payment discrepancies

  • Experience with payer portals and telephone-based payer follow-up

  • Strong ability to prioritize accounts based on age, balance, and likelihood of recovery

  • Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation skills

  • Persistence and problem-solving skills when resolving complex or delayed claims

  • Ability to work independently and meet productivity and quality expectations in a remote environment

  • HIPAA-compliant private workspace

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with specific payer types or payer-specific processes

We aren't looking for a traditional PR person. We need a Growth Specialist who lives and breathes the social media ecosystem. Industry experience is optional; a killer instinct is not. We are seeking either an emerging talent with an eye for the "next big thing" or an experienced professional looking to evolve. If you have the drive to master our algorithms and the communication skills to build lasting relationships, we will help you bridge the gap between your current skill set and industry excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Aggressive Prospecting: Proactively scout TikTok, Instagram, kick and YouTube to identify "undervalued" creators or those with high-velocity viral potential.

  • High-Stakes Outreach: Execute personalized, high-conversion outreach to talent and negotiate deal structures that align with our performance goals.

  • Data-Driven Retention: Use internal and external data tools to rigorously analyze ROI. You will be responsible for deciding, based on hard data, which partnerships to scale and which to sunset.

  • Global Coordination: Maintain constant communication with our internal teams to ensure creator content aligns with broader company objectives.

The Requirements

  • The "Eye": An innate ability to identify creators before they go viral. You understand the nuances of hook rates, engagement quality, and audience sentiment.

  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable looking at a dashboard of numbers and making cold, calculated business decisions about a partnership's viability.

  • Hyper-Availability: This isn't a 9-to-5. You must be available 7 days a week to capitalize on viral moments, respond to talent needs, and coordinate with a global team.

  • Technical Proficiency: A quick learning curve for proprietary algorithmic tools and experience (or interest) in creator CRM platforms.

  • Remote Excellence: Self-motivated and highly organized; you can manage a massive roster of talent without losing track of the details.

  • Web3 Literacy: You possess a solid understanding of the Web3 ecosystem. You are comfortable navigating decentralized platforms and are familiar with the digital tools and assets that power the modern creator economy.

Operational Details

  • Location: Fully Remote.

  • Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to handle real-time social media trends).

Why Join Us?

We offer more than just a remote role; we offer a masterclass in the future of the creator economy.

  • World-Class Mentorship: Receive hands-on training from industry experts. Whether you are an emerging talent or an established professional, you will sharpen your instincts using our proprietary tech.

  • Transferable Mastery: The skills you develop here, data analysis, high-level negotiation, and algorithmic trend forecasting, are among the most sought-after in the modern economy.

  • A Culture of Momentum: We excel at creating an environment where you are never stagnant. You will constantly be learning, applying new strategies, and moving forward.

  • High-Growth Upside: Join a team that values "potential over pedigree" and provides a clear runway for those who are driven to achieve excellence.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We’re looking for Senior Integrations Engineers to join our growing team! This role is instrumental in supporting our expansion in our hyper growth phase. You’ll play a key role in designing, building, and scaling our integrations powering our product. You’ll work alongside our engineers, implementation specialists, support, and product managers to build real-time and batch data integrations with our partners and clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Scale up our business by designing, building, and supporting our integrations and infrastructure

  • Build robust healthcare integrations without compromising security, privacy, or quality. These integrations will leverage technology standards using REST-like APIs, healthcare standards such as FHIR, and other third-party APIs.

  • Collaborate closely with our health system customers to deploy, troubleshoot, and support integrations. Be comfortable engaging with external partners and stakeholders.

  • Enhance existing systems to add new functionality, and to improve performance, stability, quality, and security

  • Advocate for high standards; make quality-of-life improvements to the codebase; add documentation and share knowledge; and help limit the growth of technical debt

  • Build deep user empathy and maintain a user-centric mindset

  • Communicate regularly and effectively within and on behalf of our cross-functional product delivery teams. You’ll work with other disciplines, including design, product, machine learning, and infrastructure, and will have opportunities to learn from and contribute to projects across the company

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience launching business-critical integrations with large enterprises

  • 2+ years of Cerner Integration experience

  • Experience with mPage Workflow components, Dynamic Documentation, and CCL

  • Experience working with technologies REST-like APIs (FHIR), OAuth2.0, mTLS

  • Excitement about working on our tech stack, which include NodeJS/TypeScript and Google Cloud Platform

  • Passionate about working in healthcare integrations

  • Ability to act with autonomy & self-direction while working well in a team environment

  • Willingness to pitch in wherever needed - as a fast-moving startup we need to do good work, quickly

  • Comfortable with working across domains and languages with a curiosity to experiment & learn new things

  • Strong communication with internal and external stakeholders

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $210.8K - $248K

raw.description:
About Cardiac Care Alliance (CCA)

Cardiac Care Alliance is a Management Services Organization (MSO) committed to building a high-performance cardiovascular network. We partner with independent cardiologists to deliver value-based care (VBC) models that complement traditional fee-for-service delivery. Our mission is to improve patient access, clinical outcomes, and overall experience through proactive care coordination and evidence-based interventions.

Position Summary

CCA is hiring full-time virtual Care Coordinators to support a growing population of medically complex patients with cardiac conditions, primarily congestive heart failure (CHF). This role is integral to our population health initiatives — proactively supporting at-risk patients with data-informed outreach, continuity of care, and patient-centered engagement.

This role will focus on supporting Principal Care Management (PCM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), and Transitional Care Management (TCM) services via telephonic outreach and technology-enabled documentation platforms. Care Coordinators work collaboratively with a team of Registered Nurses and Cardiologists, escalating clinical concerns and complex care needs as appropriate.

This position does not require RN licensure, but candidates must have strong clinical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate complex care environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct structured telephonic outreach to CHF patients and other complex cardiac patients
  • Maintain a caseload of assigned patients, using risk stratification to prioritize care
  • Complete initial assessments and timely follow-ups addressing current symptoms, medication regimen and adherence, functional and psychosocial status
  • Assess home safety and social determinants of health (SDOH) barriers, including transportation, food insecurity, housing instability, and caregiver support; escalate resource needs where appropriate
  • Advance care planning needs and specialty care follow-up
  • Review and act on population health dashboards to address care gaps (annual wellness visits, missing labs, lack of symptom monitoring, etc.)
  • Provide ongoing patient education and promote evidence-based self-management strategies for CHF
  • Monitor for signs of worsening conditions or gaps in care, and escalate as needed
  • Support transitional care follow-up within 48 hours post-discharge, focusing on medication reconciliation, red-flag symptom screening, and appointment scheduling
  • Document time, interventions, care plans, and patient goals in the care management platform in alignment with CMS billing standards
  • Maintain proactive communication with RNs, Cardiologists, PCP offices, and other clinical partners

Scope of Work – Limitations

This role is non-clinical in license and does not include:

  • Clinical assessment or medical diagnosis
  • Medication prescribing or adjustments
  • Interpretation of diagnostic results (labs, imaging, EKGs, etc.)
  • Clinical triage or emergency response
  • Home visits or in-person patient contact
  • Billing or coding responsibilities beyond required documentation

All clinical decision-making, care plan authorization, and treatment recommendations are made by licensed providers and/or supervising RNs.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Medical Assistant (MA) certification or equivalent clinical credential (e.g., CNA, EMT, CHW with experience)
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in care coordination, case management, or ambulatory care
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to build rapport by phone
  • Familiarity with CMS PCM, CCM, and/or TCM program requirements
  • Technologically proficient with care coordination software or EHRs
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote environment

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of chronic conditions, especially heart failure and associated comorbidities
  • Based in or familiar with the Dallas/Fort Worth region
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English)

Position Details

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, W-2 Contract
  • Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday (flexible business hours)
  • Compensation: $26–$32/hour (based on experience and qualifications)
  • Work Environment: 100% Remote (Dallas/Fort Worth area preferred)
  • Potential for ongoing engagement or full-time employment for the right candidate
  • Must have a dedicated, private workspace suitable for handling PHI, a secure internet connection, and comply with HIPAA and patient privacy policies at all times

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will own how this system behaves on desktop environments. Your work focuses on reliability, performance, and real-time behavior in production desktop applications.

Focus

  • Build and maintain cross-platform desktop applications using Electron.

  • Design responsive and scalable UIs for real-time collaboration.

  • Implement desktop-specific functionality including file system access, native notifications, auto-updates, and deep linking.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, agents, AI assistance) via backend APIs.

  • Optimize startup time, memory usage, and runtime performance.

  • Profile and reduce Electron overhead.

  • Manage large local state and message history efficiently.

  • Ensure smooth real-time updates (messages, typing indicators, presence).

  • Maintain stability across macOS and Windows environments.

Ideal Experiences

  • Proven software engineering experience.

  • Hands-on experience building production Electron applications.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.

  • Experience with React or similar UI frameworks.

  • Solid understanding of the desktop application lifecycle.

  • Experience with IPC communication.

  • Experience working with local storage (SQLite, IndexedDB, filesystem).

  • Experience with WebSockets or other real-time transport mechanisms.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Familiarity with native OS behaviors on macOS or Windows.

Tech Stack

  • Electron

  • Node.js

  • Typescript

  • SQl & noSQL

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

raw.description:
Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals globally. We serve over 2,000 customers—including over 50% of the Fortune 100—across 30+ countries.

At Quorum, our "product" isn't just our software; it’s our people. We are looking for a 100% remote Account Manager who is a natural relationship-builder and a strategic growth driver. This isn't just a renewal role—it’s an opportunity to act as a trusted advisor to the world’s leading public affairs teams.

The Impact You’ll Have

As an Account Manager, you are the strategic anchor for our customers. You will own a portfolio of accounts, ensuring they don't just use Quorum, but thrive on it. You’ll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of the partnership: from driving deep product adoption and proving ROI to C-Suite executives, to identifying new ways our tools can help clients achieve their mission through upselling and cross-selling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Relationship Mastery: Build long-lasting relationships with clients, moving beyond a "vendor" status to become a trusted advisor who understands their unique pain points.

  • Drive Growth: You’ll be the engine of Quorum’s revenue expansion, finding and closing opportunities to bring more of our solutions to the organizations that need them.

  • Retention & Turnarounds: You take pride in "saving" high-risk clients and turning them into loyal brand advocates who provide references and referrals.

  • Voice of the Customer: You’ll bridge the gap between our users and our Product/Engineering teams, ensuring that client feedback directly influences our roadmap.

  • AI-Forward Strategy: Leverage AI tools to synthesize account performance and automate reporting, allowing you more time to focus on high-value strategic discussions.

About You

  • The Experience: You have 3+ years in Account Management or Customer Success within the SaaS space, with a proven track record of hitting revenue and retention targets.

  • The Communicator: You are confident leading Executive Business Reviews with C-Suite leaders and can translate complex software features into measurable business impact.

  • The "People Person": You establish rapport with ease—whether in-person or online—and naturally channel empathy into effective client advocacy.

  • Tech-Passionate: You love teaching people how technology can solve their everyday problems and make their professional lives better.

  • Civic-Minded: You’re excited by the opportunity to impact politics and public affairs; perhaps you’ve worked on a campaign or are a self-proclaimed "news junkie."

About the Account Management Team

We’re responsible for ensuring that clients have an amazing experience with Quorum.

  • We are Educators: We provide team and individual product demonstrations that promote best practices in the government affairs space.

  • We are Advocates: We act as staunch advocates for our clients, identifying and responding to their unique use cases.

  • We are Creative: We are dedicated to every user’s success and address challenges quickly and creatively.

  • We are a Community: We take pride in developing personal relationships with our users and our team. We're very close—we work together, hang out together, and regularly support one another to ensure the success of our clients.

Our Work Environment

  • We are an AI-forward team—AI is built into how we work, think, and grow.

  • We are a remote-friendly team with flexible work options: work remotely or, if you're in the area, choose to visit our vibrant, sunlit space in our modern, open-concept office in Washington, D.C.

  • Our office building is located in the heart of downtown DC, easily accessible by metro, bus, and rideshares. It is also in close proximity to great restaurants, food trucks, shopping, and popular happy hour spots.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Paid Company holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Four Day Weekends for President’s Day, Memorial Day, and Labor Day

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter dedicated to your professional development!

  • Work from Home Reimbursement for home office support

  • 401k match

  • Health & Financial Wellbeing support

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Community groups open to all team members

  • Paid 12 weeks off for parental leave

Compensation

  • Base range of $65,000 - $80,000 based on experience + variable compensation.

  • This is a full-time remote position, Exempt - not eligible for overtime.

Our Commitment to Pay Transparency: What Does That Mean For You?

  • We will not ask you what you are currently earning.

  • We will consider years of relevant experience, relevant professional certifications/education, and performance expectations in setting what we believe is a competitive, fair base salary offer.

  • We will be transparent about our compensation structure so that all candidates have equal access to compensation information and can make an informed decision about whether or not Quorum is the right workplace for them.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

We are currently hiring for this position in the following states: DC, FL, GA, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NJ, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VT, VA, WV.

At Quorum, we utilize modern talent acquisition tools, including our Applicant Tracking System, Ashby, to assist our recruiting team. We use AI-assisted features solely to help us search our database, sort information, personalize our email outreach, and support interview note-taking (candidates have the option to opt out). We do not use automated tools or algorithms to screen out, rank, or make final selection or rejection decisions regarding your application. All hiring decisions are made entirely by human recruiters and hiring managers.

Business Partnership

We are IT

Our global footprint and commitment to transformation position us at the forefront of leveraging technology to create lasting business value.
