Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals globally. We serve over 2,000 customers—including over 50% of the Fortune 100—across 30+ countries.

At Quorum, our "product" isn't just our software; it’s our people. We are looking for a 100% remote Public Sector Business Development Representative to be the first impression of our company for government and public sector prospects. This isn't just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to help public sector leaders use technology to navigate the complexities of government.

The Impact You’ll Have

As a Public Sector BDR, you are a critical driver of Quorum’s annual growth. You will spend your time identifying and qualifying new business opportunities within the public sector, mapping out key stakeholders, and initiating conversations that turn prospects into long-term partners. You’ll work at the intersection of technology and policy, helping decision-makers find the tools they need to achieve their mission.

About the Revenue Team

We take pride in being the first-impression of what it is like to work with Quorum.

  • We are Solution-Oriented: We strive to understand our buyers’ challenges and recommend solutions that enable them to achieve their goals.

  • We are Thought Leaders: We follow political news and government affairs trends daily to stay ahead of the curve.

  • We are Supportive: We foster an environment where peer-to-peer feedback is encouraged to drive both personal and professional growth.

  • We are Respectful: We earn client trust by taking an intentionally respectful approach to our competition.

  • We are Growth Drivers: We understand, appreciate, and are motivated by the fact that our everyday work is a critical driver for annual company growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Outreach: Design and execute lead generation campaigns via cold-calls, email, and social media to engage decision-makers.

  • Strategic Research: Conduct deep research into public sector accounts to identify key players and tailor your positioning.

  • Drive the Pipeline: Schedule high-quality meetings for our Account Executives and manage your workflow using SalesLoft, Salesforce, and ZoomInfo.

  • AI-Forward Prospecting: Use AI and research tools to stay informed on legislative trends and automate the "administrative drag" of prospecting.

  • Collaborate: Partner closely with Marketing to align your outreach with global campaigns and company-wide objectives.

About You

  • The Experience: You have 2+ years of BDR experience specifically within the Public Sector space.

  • The Results-Driver: You have a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding high-volume outreach quotas.

  • The Communicator: You have excellent written skills and the ability to build meaningful relationships through curiosity and active listening.

  • The Tech-Forward Learner: You are comfortable with Salesforce and Salesloft, and you have a strong desire to master the art of B2B software sales.

  • The Self-Starter: You can prioritize tasks and solve problems independently while thriving in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

Our Work Environment

  • We are an AI-forward team—AI is built into how we work, think, and grow.

  • We are a remote-friendly team with flexible work options: work remotely or, if you're in the area, choose to visit our vibrant, sunlit space in our modern, open-concept office in Washington, D.C.

  • Our office building is located in the heart of downtown DC, easily accessible by metro, bus, and rideshares. It is also in close proximity to great restaurants, food trucks, shopping, and popular happy hour spots.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Paid Company holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Four Day Weekends for President’s Day, Memorial Day, and Labor Day

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter dedicated to your professional development!

  • Work from Home Reimbursement for home office support

  • 401k match

  • Health & Financial Wellbeing support

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Community groups open to all team members

  • Paid 12 weeks off for parental leave

Compensation

  • Base range of $46,000 - $50,000 based on experience + variable compensation with uncapped commissions.

  • This is a full-time remote position, Exempt - not eligible for overtime.

Our Commitment to Pay Transparency: What Does That Mean For You?

  • We will not ask you what you are currently earning.

  • We will consider years of relevant experience, relevant professional certifications/education, and performance expectations in setting what we believe is a competitive, fair base salary offer.

  • We will be transparent about our compensation structure so that all candidates have equal access to compensation information and can make an informed decision about whether or not Quorum is the right workplace for them.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

We are currently hiring for this position in the following states: DC, FL, GA, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NJ, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VT, VA, WV.

AI Disclosure:

At Quorum, we utilize modern talent acquisition tools, including our Applicant Tracking System, Ashby, to assist our recruiting team. We use AI-assisted features solely to help us search our database, sort information, personalize our email outreach, and support interview note-taking (candidates have the option to opt out). All hiring decisions are made entirely by human recruiters and hiring managers.

Agency Website: www.dmv.virginia.gov

Recruitment Type: State Employee Only - E

Job Duties

Remote work opportunity! These are hourly/wage positions without state benefits and is open to current state employees only. The Virginia Department of Motor Vehicle’s (DMV) Medical Review Services (MRS) Unit is hiring multiple Customer Service Specialists who will be responsible for reviewing and evaluating medical information, and communicating requirements to MRS customers regarding their MRS orders via phone or writing. In this position, you will help MRS customers understand the requirements and what documents are needed, based on state and federal laws and regulations, for a driver’s license, commercial driver’s license (CDL), a bioptic-telescopic (BTL) lens certification, CDL disability waiver, or CDL hazardous materials variance.

Wage positions are limited to no more than 1,500 hours per agency during the 12-month period of May 1 – April 30, regardless of the hire date. The wage employment period resets on May 1 of the following year. All wage employees are limited to working no more than 29 hours per week, on average, over the 12-month period.

Core Responsibilities Include:

  • Respond to calls/inquiries from DMV’s Customer Service Centers (CSCs) and Customer Contact Center (CCC) personnel, customers, physicians, attorneys, and courts pertaining to the status or evaluation of medical cases in accordance with agency and work center appropriate statutes, policies and procedures
    •Index manual documents/faxes/certified mail to customer records as assigned
    •Record all notes into customer's 'nurses notes' file in the OnBase system

    Initial training for these positions will be completed in-person during the first 2 weeks of employment. After training has been completed, the incumbent will transition to 100% remote work.

    The Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, serves approximately 6.2 million licensed drivers and ID card holders with over 8.4 million registered vehicles. In addition, DMV serves many businesses, including dealers, fuel tax customers, rental companies, driving schools, other state agencies, local governments, and non-profit organizations. DMV operates upon five fundamental core values: Trustworthiness, Respect, Accountability, Integrity, and Teamwork (TRAIT). We don’t just talk about our core values. We live them!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Considerable knowledge of medical terminology
    •Experience working in a medical setting, evaluating and communicating requirements regarding medical information

•Experience providing customer service

  • Experience operating a computer (Microsoft Office, Databases)
    •Demonstrated ability to understand and follow policies and procedures
    •Ability to work additional hours and some Saturdays as needed based on the needs of the work center

Additional Considerations

  • Currently licensed or certified and practicing as a medical technologist is preferred

•Prior call center experience

Special Instructions

You will be provided a confirmation of receipt when your application and/or résumé is submitted successfully. Please refer to “Your Application” in your account to check the status of your application for this position.

Selected candidate(s) will need to complete the I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification Form. DMV participates in E-Verify.

All applicants for employment must consent to a driver history and criminal background check. A fingerprint-based criminal history check will be required on selected applicant(s).

Submission of an online application is required. DMV does not accept applications, resumes, cover letters, etc. in any other format. When applying for jobs, please ensure your online application or resume is complete with duties and skills associated with your work experience as well as years of experience in order to properly assess your skills in the screening process. Candidates are evaluated based on information provided in the application materials. Missing information cannot be assumed.

Reasonable accommodations are available to persons with disabilities during application and/or interview processes per the Americans with Disability Act. Contact 804-367-9728 for assistance.

Email:

We Are Innovators & Category Creators

Clickatell, founded in Cape Town in 2000, was the first company to connect businesses with consumers via SMS using just four lines of code. Today, it powers AI-driven chat commerce for leading global brands across industries like banking, retail, telecoms, and healthcare. Over 25 years, Clickatell has led multiple industry firsts through its award-winning AI Chat Commerce Platform, enabling brands to connect, interact, and transact with customers seamlessly.

The Role

As a Research and Development Engineer: Innovation (Intermediate), you are a key driver of our R&D initiatives, responsible for taking ownership of complex features and technical challenges. You will collaborate with engineers and researchers to design and implement innovative solutions that enhance our SaaS platform. This role marks a transition into an "Independent Solver," where you are expected to navigate ambiguity and lead small "Tactical Pods" or projects from ideation to execution. You play a vital role in mentoring junior talent and graduates, ensuring our innovation efforts are modular, scalable, and aligned with the "Big Picture" of our systems architecture.

We Do The Right Things

Responsibilities of the Role

o Research and Analysis: Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor products to identify opportunities for innovation.

o Idea Generation: Brainstorm, conceptualize, and propose innovative ideas and solutions that can improve our SaaS products.

o Prototyping: Develop proof-of-concept prototypes to test and validate new ideas, leveraging your technical skills.

o Collaborative Innovation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software developers, designers, and product managers, to bring innovation projects to life.

o Documentation: Document research findings, design concepts, and development processes to maintain a clear and organized record of innovation efforts.

o Testing and Validation: Assist in testing and validation of new features, ensuring they meet the highest quality standards.

o Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

o Independent Solutioning: Take ownership of complex "Stories" and navigate ambiguity by figuring out how to build a solution from high-level requirements with minimal oversight.

o Feature Ownership & Integration: Manage the end-to-end development of specific features, ensuring that code is not only functional but modular, data-driven, and seamlessly integrates into the broader SaaS architecture.

o Technical Quality Assurance: Perform rigorous peer reviews and self-testing to ensure all delivered code is "Day 2" ready—meaning it is extendable, secure, and maintains system performance as it moves toward production readiness.

o Active Mentorship: Support the growth of Junior Engineers and Graduates by providing technical guidance on their tasks, performing constructive code reviews, and helping them navigate the department's "Way of Work."

We Are On A Learning Journey

Requirements of the Role

o Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

o Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or C++.

o A passion for innovation and a keen interest in emerging technologies.

o Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

o Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team.

o Demonstrates Eagerness to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges.

o Knowledge of SaaS and cloud computing is essential.

o Minimum of 2–4 years of experience with a track record of "figuring out how to build it" and working alone.

o Experience taking ownership of a full "Story" from initial requirement to a functional, integrated feature.

o Ability to provide constructive code reviews and technical support to Junior engineers and Graduates.

o Good AI understanding and daily use in a responsible way.

A Bit About You

Behavioral competency requirements of a Highflyer:

o Team Player: Self-directed and dedicated team player who positively engages with the team to solve.

o Optimizing Processes: Optimally utilizes the tools and resources available to maximizes output. Conducts day-to-day operations using best practice to achieve effectiveness and accuracy. Continuously reviews and makes recommendations for process improvements.

o Expert Thinker: Equipped with specialist knowledge and makes recommendations that are practical, smart and ready to implement. Remains up-to-date in the industry and offers technical advice, and support to own team and others.

o Effective Problem-Solver: Resourceful, persistent, and creative when solving problems. Able to be analytical and follow a logical process to make decisions. Finds the balance between a good and quick decision through experience and knowledge. Able to present and explain thinking and the resulting decision.

o Connecting Collaboratively: Actively connects to bring cohesion and deliver excellence. Sees the value in working closely with different specialities and teams to ensure all operations are aligned to meet the required objectives.

o Maximizing Awareness: Recognizes emotions and how it affects behavior and relationships. Self-aware and picks up on emotional cues in situations. Self-manages and empowered to show initiative, follow through on commitments, and work well in a team. Listens, reflects, and responds effectively to constructive criticism.

o Enabling Strategy: Implements the action plans in order to produce practical outputs while considering the implication, and consequences for the organization and our customers.

o Action Orientated Mindset: Know-how to skilfully approach technical activities to deliver value. Eager to deliver new or improved solutions to drive the organization forward. Focused on what needs to be done and ensures follow-through on all commitments.

o Embracing Change: Invites change and stays focused and resilient, and chooses responses that are positive when feeling uncertain. Remains flexible, adaptable, and open to opportunities to be innovative. Uses failure as an opportunity to learn and grows. Thinks ahead, anticipates, and acts.

o Driving Delivery: Goal-oriented and monitors processes and systems to ensure tracking towards goals despite challenging and stressful situations. Sets high standards for quality and performance and provides metrics to show improvements as well as real-time variance for effective tracking.

Why You Should Join

Perks of the Role

o Medical Aid contribution

o Pension fund contribution

o Quarterly performance incentive bonus

o Risk benefit company contributions

o Reimbursable communications allowance for internet and mobile phone bills

o Half-day off on your birthday

o 5 personal days leave a year, over and above your annual leave

o Remote Working (our offices are currently open for essential use only due to COVID-19)

o Home office set-up with laptop, monitor and other related items.

Stronger Together

At Clickatell, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of who we are - from how we build our product platforms to how we build our workforce. We believe that we are stronger together and by leveraging the power of diversity and inclusion, we are able to generate innovative ideas to revolutionize the way the world uses chat technology. We create common ground - Our platform is for all, and so is our workplace. Everyone is welcome at Clickatell and our employees feel psychologically safe and empowered to show up with their authentic selves at work.

We are looking for a proactive Backend Engineer who is ready to grow while working on a complex, high-load system in the life sciences domain.

This is a challenging role. You will work on non-trivial problems, collaborate closely with experienced engineers, and be expected to take ownership of outcomes — not just complete assigned tasks. We value pragmatic thinkers who can break down complex problems, make sound technical decisions, and consistently deliver incremental value.

In this role, you will:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of complex User Stories and actively contribute to feature analysis and solution design, from refining requirements to delivering production-ready solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers on system design and implementation, proactively proposing technical solutions and taking ownership of decisions within your scope.
  • Contribute to the evolution of core backend components and APIs.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and participate in refactoring initiatives.
  • Optimize database queries and backend components for performance and scalability, and investigate performance bottlenecks in your areas of ownership.
  • Break down complex tasks into pragmatic, deliverable increments.
  • Proactively suggest backend and technical improvements that enhance product reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to improving engineering practices and development processes.

We would like you to have:

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering;
  • strong foundation in computer science (OOP, data structures, algorithms);
  • solid experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL);
  • experience working with ClickHouse (writing and optimizing queries);
  • strong proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin;
  • strong practical experience with Spring Framework in production systems;
  • hands-on experience writing automated tests (functional and integration);
  • ability to independently drive complex User Stories to completion and make sound technical decisions within your scope;
  • strong practical use of AI tools to improve development efficiency and code quality, with readiness to share effective practices within the team;
  • strong communication skills and fluent English;
  • interest in life sciences or willingness to work in the domain.

It would be nice if you have:

  • knowledge of biology or genetics;
  • experience with large datasets or analytical systems;
  • knowledge of Python;
  • experience with React.js.

Why Join Us:

  • Solve complex technical challenges in a meaningful scientific domain.
  • Take high ownership and make a real impact on product direction.
  • Be part of an engineering-driven culture with pragmatic decision-making.
  • Grow technically while influencing system architecture.

We offer you:

  • international team of professionals;
  • comfortable office in the very heart of the historical center of Belgrade;
  • opportunity to work 100% remotely;
  • medical insurance, fully paid sick leaves;
  • onboarding and domain training for newcomers;
  • flexible work schedule.

Remote (within South Africa)

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineer to own quality across our product. This person will sit closely with the engineering team, speak their language, and ensure everything we ship is solid, well-tested, and production-ready. This is our first dedicated QA hire, with real ownership and room to grow into building out a QA function and team as we scale.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure features are built to match product requirements and acceptance criteria
  • Verify features are working correctly and free of bugs before release
  • Own production smoke testing after every deploy and flag regressions quickly
  • Identify, document, and track defects through to resolution
  • Build and maintain test plans, test cases, and QA documentation

  • Technically minded — understands software beyond the UI and can reason about how systems work
  • Ability to dig into technical issues, not just surface-level UI bugs
  • Strong communicator who can bridge product and engineering
  • Detail-oriented and proactive — actively seeks out issues rather than waiting for them to surface
  • Confident pushing back when something isn't right
  • Good team player

Major Pluses (Any One of These Moves a Candidate to the Top)

  • Deep payroll, HR, or benefits domain experience — candidates with a background in payroll operations, HR tech, benefits administration, or 401(k), combined with technical aptitude, are strongly encouraged to apply. Understanding how the system should behave is often more valuable than knowing how to test it
  • Software development background — hands-on experience writing or reading code in any language. Understanding how code works, not just how to break it
  • QA experience — manual testing, test case design, defect tracking, or experience as the first/solo QA at a company
  • Test automation experience — Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar. We'll get there, and we'd value someone who can lead that effort
  • API testing (Postman or similar)
  • SQL comfort for verifying data behind the UI
  • Prior experience in a fast-moving tech environment

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Fabric Developer to join a fast-growing data and analytics programme. This role sits at the intersection of Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled data platforms.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining Microsoft Fabric data products, Power BI reporting solutions, and data pipelines that support both business stakeholders and AI-driven solutions.

This is a hands-on delivery role suited to someone who enjoys building, maintaining, and improving data solutions rather than operating purely at an architectural level.

The role is fully remote and offers the opportunity to work with modern Microsoft technologies including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Services, and AI-related data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft Fabric Development

  • Build and maintain solutions within Microsoft Fabric Workspaces.
  • Develop and support Fabric Lakehouses.
  • Design and maintain Dataflows Gen2.
  • Understand and manage data movement throughout the Fabric ecosystem.
  • Maintain Fabric semantic models and reporting datasets.

Power BI Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Build scalable and well-structured semantic models.
  • Develop advanced DAX measures and calculated columns.
  • Create meaningful visualisations and reporting solutions for business stakeholders.
  • Optimise report performance and usability.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain data pipelines within Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Factory.
  • Ingest data from multiple sources including:
    • SQL Databases
    • APIs
    • SharePoint Lists
    • CSV and Flat Files
    • External Data Sources
  • Implement data transformation and cleansing processes.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline failures.

SQL Development

  • Write complex SQL queries for reporting and transformation purposes.
  • Develop views and transformation logic.
  • Create data structures that support analytics and AI workloads.
  • Ensure data quality and consistency across reporting layers.

Python / PySpark Development

  • Develop and maintain Fabric notebooks.
  • Perform data transformation using Python and PySpark.
  • Support automation and data engineering activities.
  • Work with GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools where appropriate.

AI Data Platform Support

  • Support AI-enabled data environments.
  • Prepare and maintain Gold Layer datasets.
  • Assist with Azure AI Search indexing and synchronisation.
  • Support Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) data structures.
  • Ensure AI solutions have access to accurate, current, and well-governed data.

Platform Operations

  • Monitor data pipeline health and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot data quality and integration issues.
  • Ensure business-critical reporting environments remain operational.
  • Stay current with Microsoft Fabric enhancements and new platform capabilities.

Essential Requirements

To be considered, applicants must have:

  • 4–8 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Development.
  • Proven hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience.
  • Experience working with:
    • Fabric Workspaces
    • Lakehouses
    • Dataflows Gen2
  • Strong Power BI development experience.
  • Strong data modelling capability.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.
  • Python and/or PySpark experience.
  • Experience working with data orchestration and scheduling tools.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
  • A genuine interest in AI-enabled data platforms and emerging technologies.

Highly Desirable Experience

Candidates with the following will be highly advantageous:

  • Azure AI Search
  • Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) environments
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Power BI Service Administration
  • Row-Level Security (RLS)
  • Deployment Pipelines
  • Delta Lake Architecture
  • Bronze, Silver and Gold Data Layer Design
  • Incremental Load Strategies
  • KQL (Kusto Query Language)
  • Real-time analytics solutions

Certifications

The following certifications will be advantageous:

  • PL-300 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst
  • DP-600 Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer
  • DP-900 Azure Data Fundamentals

Relevant hands-on experience will be considered more important than certifications alone.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a technically strong, delivery-focused professional who enjoys building solutions, solving data challenges, and working with modern Microsoft technologies.

You should be comfortable getting hands-on with data pipelines, reporting, transformations, and AI-related data structures while collaborating with senior technical stakeholders.

raw.description:
Our client, a Private Equity backed payments company serving merchants across the United States and Canada, is seeking a Chief Financial Officer to support its next stage of growth. The role is suited for a finance leader with deep payments experience and a strong understanding of the financial complexity of merchant acquiring.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the finance and accounting function for a private equity-backed payments company.
  • Partner with the CEO, private equity sponsor, and executive leadership team on financial strategy, business planning, and company performance.
  • Build stronger financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and board reporting processes.
  • Provide clear visibility into processing volume, merchant performance, revenue streams, residuals, costs, margins, and portfolio trends.
  • Improve financial discipline across merchant acquiring, ISV partnerships, sponsor bank relationships, and ancillary payment solutions.
  • Strengthen finance systems, controls, processes, and reporting as the company scales.
  • Support investor reporting, board communication, lender relationships, and private equity ownership requirements.
  • Partner across sales, product, risk, underwriting, operations, and technology to improve visibility into business performance.
  • Help evaluate growth opportunities, new products, partnerships, geographic expansion, and potential acquisitions.
  • Lead cash management, capital planning, compliance-related financial oversight, and risk-informed decision-making.
  • Build, lead, and develop the finance team.

What You Bring

  • Senior finance leadership experience in payments, merchant acquiring, payment processing, gateways, ISOs, sponsor bank models, embedded payments, or related fintech environments.
  • Strong understanding of payments revenue complexity, merchant acquiring economics, residual reporting, portfolio performance, processing costs, and interchange economics.
  • Experience working in a private equity-backed company or directly with private equity sponsors, boards, and investors.
  • Ability to connect financial reporting to business performance, operating metrics, and growth decisions.
  • Experience building reporting, forecasting, budgeting, controls, and scalable finance processes.
  • Comfort operating in a growing middle-market company where the CFO needs to be strategic, hands-on, and close to the details.
  • Experience with board reporting, investor communication, capital planning, and business performance reviews.
  • Ability to partner with sales, product, risk, underwriting, operations, technology, and executive leadership.
  • Experience with merchant portfolios, sponsor bank oversight, residuals, ISO or agent models, ISV partnerships, or complex merchant verticals.
  • CPA preferred, but not required.

  • Experience working in a private equity-backed company or directly with private equity sponsors, boards, and investors.
  • Ability to connect financial reporting to business performance, operating metrics, and growth decisions.
  • Experience building reporting, forecasting, budgeting, controls, and scalable finance processes.

  • Experience with board reporting, investor communication, capital planning, and business performance reviews.
  • Ability to partner with sales, product, risk, underwriting, operations, technology, and executive leadership.
